theme.en: AI Expansion Tests Supply Chains and Policy
theme.zh: AI扩张考验供应链与政策边界

dek.en: New inference funding and supercomputing support broaden the demand picture as reports point to rising HBM prices and continued investment in domestic equipment. A Texas fab incentive decision and renewed export-control pressure show how policy shapes the next wave of capacity.
dek.zh: 新的推理集群融资与超算资助拓宽算力需求，HBM涨价预期和国产设备投入则凸显供应端压力。得州晶圆厂激励审批与再起的出口管制争议，显示政策正在塑造下一轮产能布局。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: NCSA Gains Supercomputing Support Through a $334 Million Grant
title.zh: NCSA获3.34亿美元资助支持超算能力建设

summary.en: The Next Platform reports that NCSA is gaining supercomputing capacity through a $334 million Schmidt Sciences grant. The commitment adds a research-computing dimension to infrastructure spending; the supplied headline does not specify the processor mix, system performance or deployment schedule.
summary.zh: 据The Next Platform报道，NCSA将通过Schmidt Sciences提供的3.34亿美元资助增强超算能力。这笔投入为算力基础设施建设增添了科研需求，但所提供的标题未披露处理器配置、系统性能或部署时间表。

title.en: Moores Lab AI Puts Chip Verification Outcomes at the Center of Benchmarking
title.zh: Moores Lab AI以芯片验证结果作为基准测试重点

summary.en: Moores Lab AI is pursuing a benchmark initiative focused on whether AI can establish that chip designs behave correctly. SemiWiki describes an emphasis on verification outcomes rather than generated-code volume or apparent sophistication. That distinction matters when assessing whether hardware-generation tools reduce the engineering work required to reach a verified design.
summary.zh: Moores Lab AI正在推进一项基准测试计划，重点检验AI能否确认芯片设计的行为正确。SemiWiki指出，该计划强调验证结果，而非生成代码的数量或表面复杂程度。这有助于判断硬件代码生成工具能否真正减少完成设计验证所需的工程工作。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: Texas Comptroller Approves JETI Step for Potential TSMC Fab
title.zh: 得州审计长批准拟议台积电晶圆厂的JETI激励事项

summary.en: WTAW reports that the Texas comptroller has approved a JETI incentive step for a potential TSMC fab in Brazos County, with a CSISD hearing set for December 10. This advances the local incentive process, while the project's description as potential leaves construction and a final investment commitment unconfirmed in the supplied report.
summary.zh: 据WTAW报道，得州审计长已批准布拉索斯县拟议台积电晶圆厂的一项JETI激励事项，CSISD听证会定于12月10日举行。这推动了当地激励审批程序，但所提供的报道仍将项目称为拟议项目，尚未确认开工或最终投资承诺。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: Report Points to a Doubling of HBM Prices
title.zh: 报道称HBM价格或将翻倍

summary.en: Chosun Ilbo reports an expected doubling of HBM prices alongside market disruption involving major technology companies. If realized, that would increase a key component cost for AI accelerators and strengthen memory suppliers' pricing position. The supplied headline does not identify the HBM generation, contract period or comparison base, so the figure cannot be applied uniformly across products.
summary.zh: 《朝鲜日报》报道称，HBM价格预计翻倍，大型科技公司的动向正在影响市场。若这一预期兑现，将推高AI加速器的关键部件成本，并增强存储供应商的议价能力。所提供的标题未说明HBM代际、合约期限或比较基期，因此不能将这一涨幅一概套用于所有产品。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: SKMP Plans Ultra-High-Purity Semiconductor Thinner Supply in December
title.zh: SKMP计划12月开始供应超高纯半导体稀释剂

summary.en: The Elec reports that SKMP plans to begin supplying ultra-high-purity semiconductor thinner in December. The planned start adds a materials-supply milestone to the manufacturing pipeline, although the supplied report does not disclose customers, production volume or qualification details.
summary.zh: 据The Elec报道，SKMP计划于12月开始供应超高纯半导体稀释剂。这为半导体制造材料供应增添了一个明确的时间节点，但所提供的报道未披露客户、产量或认证细节。

title.en: EuvLight Raises About 50 Million Yuan for EUV Light-Source Development
title.zh: EuvLight融资约5000万元推进EUV光源研发

summary.en: Shenzhen EuvLight Technology has raised roughly 50 million yuan in Pre-A financing, according to Wccftech's account of local reporting. The company is developing laser-produced-plasma EUV sources and says its approach uses cheaper EUV mirrors and wider tin nozzles. Funding supports an important domestic equipment component, but a light-source prototype alone does not establish scanner integration or production readiness.
summary.zh: Wccftech援引当地报道，称深圳EuvLight Technology完成约5000万元Pre-A轮融资。该公司正在研发激光等离子体EUV光源，并称其方案采用成本更低的EUV反射镜和更宽的锡喷嘴。这笔融资支持国产设备关键部件研发，但光源原型本身尚不能证明整机集成能力或量产成熟度。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: Schumer Accuses Nvidia CEO of Breaking US Export-Control Law
title.zh: 舒默指控英伟达CEO违反美国出口管制法律

summary.en: Reuters reports that Chuck Schumer has accused Nvidia's chief executive of violating US export-control law. The allegation adds political pressure around access to advanced chips and Nvidia's export exposure. It is an accusation; the supplied item does not establish an adjudicated violation or disclose a new enforcement outcome.
summary.zh: 据路透社报道，查克·舒默指控英伟达首席执行官违反美国出口管制法律。这项指控增加了围绕先进芯片获取及英伟达出口业务的政治压力。目前这仍属指控，所提供的条目未表明已有违法裁定，也未披露新的执法结果。

title.en: China Halts Critical-Minerals Ban to Preserve US Truce, Bloomberg Reports
title.zh: 彭博社：中国暂停关键矿产禁令以维持对美休战

summary.en: Bloomberg reports that China has halted a critical-minerals ban to maintain its truce with the United States. The move could ease one source of uncertainty for electronics and materials supply chains. The supplied headline does not specify the minerals, duration or licensing conditions, so it does not establish unrestricted trade in affected inputs.
summary.zh: 据彭博社报道，中国暂停关键矿产禁令，以维持与美国的贸易休战。此举有望缓解电子及材料供应链的一项不确定性。所提供的标题未说明涉及矿种、暂停期限或许可条件，因此尚不能据此认定相关材料已恢复自由贸易。

title.en: Challengers
title.zh: 新兴挑战者

title.en: Marlowe Raises $277 Million for Inference Clusters Using Nvidia Rivals
title.zh: Marlowe融资2.77亿美元，建设采用英伟达竞品芯片的推理集群

summary.en: SiliconANGLE reports that Marlowe has raised $277 million to build inference clusters using chips from Nvidia competitors. The financing puts capital behind alternative accelerator deployments at the cluster level. The supplied item does not identify the selected chips or provide comparative cost and performance results.
summary.zh: 据SiliconANGLE报道，Marlowe融资2.77亿美元，将使用英伟达竞争对手的芯片建设推理集群。这笔资金为替代加速器的集群级部署提供支持。所提供的条目未披露所选芯片，也未提供成本和性能对比结果。

title.en: Rebellions Reportedly Wins an AI Server Deal with SK Telecom
title.zh: Rebellions据报获得SK Telecom的AI服务器订单

summary.en: DigiTimes reports that Rebellions has secured an AI server deal with SK Telecom. A server customer would provide a route from accelerator development to deployed systems for the Korean chip challenger. The supplied item does not disclose order value, shipment volume or the deployment timetable.
summary.zh: 据DigiTimes报道，Rebellions已获得SK Telecom的AI服务器订单。对这家韩国芯片新兴厂商而言，服务器客户为加速器从研发走向系统部署提供了落地路径。所提供的条目未披露订单金额、出货规模或部署时间表。

theme.en: Hardware Efficiency Depends on Models and Verification
theme.zh: 硬件效率取决于建模与验证

dek.en: Nine preprints examine interconnect reliability, power-control contracts, circuit reconstruction, thermal analysis and memory-centric acceleration. The selection connects physical constraints with inference execution, keeping FPGA demonstrations, post-layout studies and architectural proposals distinct.
dek.zh: 本期9篇预印本涵盖互连可靠性、电源控制契约、电路重建、热分析与存储中心加速。选文将物理约束与推理执行联系起来，并区分FPGA演示、布局后评估和架构提案的证据层次。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: A Solute-Aware Model Revisits Electromigration in Al-Cu Interconnects
title.zh: 考虑溶质演化的模型重新评估Al-Cu互连电迁移

papers.authors: Narahara Chari Dingari, David R. Heskett

summary.en: The authors couple copper redistribution to the Korhonen stress equation on random grain maps, separating mobile dissolved copper from immobile precipitates. Simulations use 1,000 maps per condition at 200 °C for wide, narrow and near-bamboo Al-Cu lines; assuming all copper is mobile exaggerates the nucleation-time reduction by a further factor of 2.24–2.36 at 2 wt% copper. The result shows why solute state and microstructure matter in lifetime prediction, while remaining a modelling study rather than a measured device-lifetime result.
summary.zh: 作者在随机晶粒分布上，将铜再分布与Korhonen应力方程耦合，并区分可迁移的固溶铜与不可迁移的析出相。仿真在200 °C下对宽线、窄线和近竹节状Al-Cu线的每种条件使用1000组晶粒分布；在铜含量为2 wt%时，将全部铜视为可迁移会进一步夸大成核时间的缩短，幅度达2.24至2.36倍。研究说明，寿命预测需要考虑溶质状态和微观结构，但这些仍是模型结果，而非器件寿命实测。

title.en: Circuits & Reliability
title.zh: 电路与可靠性

title.en: Lightswitch Links Digital Power-Control Requests to Physical Completion
title.zh: Lightswitch将数字电源控制请求与物理完成条件关联

papers.authors: Sabrina Yarzada, Paul Yi-Chia Chen, Yuanhan Li, et al.

summary.en: This work proposes checkable logical-physical contracts for reusable on-die power-control services, combining formally verified digital guarantees with physically validated completion conditions. The Lightswitch proof of concept is assessed using post-layout designs in TSMC 28 nm. It addresses the gap between issuing a digital power request and ensuring the physical action has completed; the supplied abstract does not report fabricated-silicon measurements.
summary.zh: 研究为可复用的片上电源控制服务提出可检查的逻辑—物理契约，将经过形式验证的数字保证与经过物理验证的完成条件结合。作者以Lightswitch为概念验证，并使用台积电28 nm工艺的布局后设计进行评估。该方法针对数字电源请求发出与物理动作实际完成之间的衔接问题；所提供的摘要未报告流片实测结果。

title.en: Design Automation & Verification
title.zh: 设计自动化与验证

title.en: ChiProgramBench Tests Circuit Reconstruction Through Pin-Level Experiments
title.zh: ChiProgramBench通过引脚级实验测试电路重建能力

papers.authors: Tianrun Gou, Qingyao Yang, Wendong Xu, et al.

summary.en: ChiProgramBench introduces 18 tasks in which agents probe hidden stateful circuits through their pins and submit replacement gate-level netlists. Across 432 trials with six agent configurations, only 12.0% of black-box trials and 14.8% of function-guided trials pass every hidden test. Power, delay and area receive credit only after full functional success, making the benchmark relevant to whether AI can recover both circuit behavior and efficient implementations.
summary.zh: ChiProgramBench提出18项任务，要求智能体通过引脚探测隐藏的有状态电路，再提交替代的门级网表。在六种智能体配置的432次试验中，仅12.0%的黑盒试验和14.8%的功能提示试验通过全部隐藏测试。只有功能完全通过后，功耗、延迟和面积才计入评分，因此该基准有助于检验AI能否同时恢复电路行为并生成高效实现。

title.en: HLWalk Accelerates Thermal Analysis of Heterogeneous 2.5D and 3D ICs
title.zh: HLWalk加速异构2.5D与3D芯片热分析

papers.authors: Qibo Xue, Shengnan Cai, Tianshu Hou, et al.

summary.en: HLWalk combines local boundary-integral reconstruction, modal splitting and scale-aware random walks to analyze heterogeneous 2.5D and 3D ICs. Low-order modes are solved deterministically while Monte Carlo sampling handles the residual, targeting boundary error and the cost of resolving fine structures such as TSVs. The authors report faster wall-clock execution and better accuracy on IC benchmarks, but the supplied abstract provides no numerical speedup or error bounds.
summary.zh: HLWalk结合局部边界积分重构、模态分裂及尺度感知随机游走，对异构2.5D和3D芯片进行热分析。它确定性求解低阶模态，仅对剩余部分采用蒙特卡洛采样，以降低边界误差和解析TSV等精细结构的计算成本。作者报告其在芯片基准上运行更快、精度更高，但所提供的摘要未给出具体加速比或误差界限。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: Pudding Makes Processing-Using-DRAM Compilation Retargetable
title.zh: Pudding支持面向DRAM内计算的可重定向编译

papers.authors: Tianrui Zheng, João Paulo Cardoso de Lima, Alexander Kusnezoff, et al.

summary.en: Pudding proposes an MLIR-based compiler that makes a Processing-Using-DRAM architecture description an explicit input, allowing retargeting without hard-coding each architecture into the compiler. Tensor-level passes use bit-slicing, mixed precision and ILP-based placement, while logic-level equality saturation explores Boolean implementations. The aim is to reduce PUD commands and inter-bank movement across different memory-computing designs; the supplied excerpt does not include evaluation results.
summary.zh: Pudding提出基于MLIR的编译器，将DRAM内计算架构描述作为显式输入，从而避免为每种架构在编译器中硬编码支持。张量层采用位切片、混合精度和基于整数线性规划的放置，逻辑层则通过等式饱和搜索布尔实现。目标是在不同存储计算设计间减少PUD指令和存储体间数据搬移；所提供的摘录未包含评测结果。

title.en: ANOR Splits Sparse Attention Between GPU Cache Hits and PNM Misses
title.zh: ANOR让GPU处理稀疏注意力缓存命中、PNM处理未命中

papers.authors: Hyunsu Ye, Hyunmin Choi, Jaehong Cho, et al.

summary.en: ANOR proposes a GPU-PNM hierarchy that retains the full KV cache near memory while caching recently selected entries on the GPU. Most attention runs on GPU cache hits, and CXL-attached PNM devices process misses directly, allowing GPU cache updates to be separated from current-step execution. This targets the bandwidth imbalance that can leave GPUs waiting in PNM-centric systems; the supplied abstract cuts off before performance results.
summary.zh: ANOR提出GPU与近存计算协同的层次结构，在近存侧保留完整KV-cache，并在GPU缓存近期被选中的条目。大部分注意力计算利用GPU缓存命中完成，连接CXL的PNM设备直接处理未命中，使GPU缓存更新可与当前解码步解耦。该方案针对以PNM为中心的系统中带宽不均衡导致GPU等待的问题；所提供的摘要在性能结果之前已截断。

title.en: EdgeALM Runs Large Audio Language Models on an 8 GB FPGA Card
title.zh: EdgeALM在8 GB FPGA卡上运行大型音频语言模型

papers.authors: Chenglin Yang, Feifan Xu, Xingyuan Li, et al.

summary.en: EdgeALM combines AWQ-style quantization, modality-conditioned vocabulary pruning and concurrent convolution and matrix engines in an FPGA accelerator. On one Alveo U50 with 8 GB of HBM, the authors demonstrate more than 20 models, including models up to 13 billion parameters, and report audio-to-text throughput up to 169.5 tokens/s. This is a hardware implementation rather than an architecture-only proposal, although the supplied excerpt does not identify the model and operating conditions associated with peak throughput.
summary.zh: EdgeALM在FPGA加速器中结合AWQ式量化、按模态条件进行的词表剪枝，以及并行工作的卷积与矩阵引擎。作者在一块配备8 GB HBM的Alveo U50上演示了20余个模型，其中包括最大130亿参数的模型，并报告音频转文本吞吐最高169.5 tokens/s。这提供了实际硬件实现证据，但所提供的摘录未说明峰值吞吐对应的模型及运行条件。

title.en: Inference Systems & Quantization
title.zh: 推理系统与量化

title.en: DECAL Calibrates Diffusion LLM Quantization for Parallel Decoding
title.zh: DECAL面向并行解码校准扩散大模型量化

papers.authors: Huan Xu, Maosen Zhao, Pengtao Chen, Tao Chen

summary.en: This study finds that W4A4 quantization of diffusion LLMs causes most quantization-induced decision flips at forced token commitments, while compressed logit gaps can also increase the number of forward passes. DECAL weights calibration by commitment risk under the deployed decoder and adds an argmax-preserving commitment temperature to recover parallelism. On LLaDA and Dream it reports the best average accuracy among the compared W4A4 methods, showing why fixed-step, uncached calibration can miss deployment-specific costs.
summary.zh: 研究发现，扩散大模型的W4A4量化所引起的决策翻转，多数出现在强制确定词元的步骤；logit间距缩小还可能增加前向传播次数。DECAL依据实际部署解码器下的提交风险调整校准权重，并使用保持argmax不变的提交温度来恢复并行度。作者报告，在LLaDA与Dream上，该方法在所比较的W4A4方案中平均准确率最高，说明固定步数且不使用缓存的校准可能遗漏部署中的特定成本。

title.en: Quantum Computing Systems
title.zh: 量子计算系统

title.en: Schism Reconfigures Resource Sharing Across Quantum Processors
title.zh: Schism动态重构量子处理器间的资源共享

papers.authors: Daniel Alexander, Deeksha P Rao, Nilesh Vyas, Vamsi Addanki

summary.en: Schism proposes reconfigurable scale-up domains that change which quantum processors share Bell-state measurement resources without moving processors or migrating quantum states. Photonic switching groups processors within an optical-loss budget, balancing path loss against contention as communication patterns change. The architecture addresses uneven resource use in distributed quantum systems, but the supplied excerpt does not include quantified evaluation results.
summary.zh: Schism提出可重构的扩展域，在不移动量子处理器或迁移量子态的情况下，改变各处理器共享Bell态测量资源的方式。光子交换在光损耗预算内对处理器分组，并随通信模式变化权衡光路损耗与资源争用。该架构针对分布式量子系统中的资源利用不均衡问题，但所提供的摘录未包含量化评测结果。
